FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 7 MD&A, client metrics
source.quote: Client assets (in billions, at year end) 18 % $ 11,903.0 $ 10,101.3 $ 8,516.6

ecosystem.notes: Client assets are a stock (the market value at period end of all client assets in Schwab's custody, BDA balances and proprietary products, cash and securities). No take rate is computed on them. The 10-K also reports net new client assets of $498.6 billion in 2025 (core: $519.4 billion); that is net client money moved onto the platform, not volume transacted through it, so it is not used as a measure. Total net revenues include net interest revenue ($11.75 billion in 2025).
